title: 同一份健康感受，用两种方式分别记录 / Two ways to check in with your health

interpretations.headline: 怎样概括整体健康感受？
interpretations.scoreLabel: 总体健康自评（五档编码）
interpretations.summary:
这项回答来自你对整体健康的五档评价。系统按附录换算为 0、25、50、75 或 100，越高表示自评越好。这里记录的是你的总体感受，无法辨认具体病因。

This item converts your five-choice general health rating to 0, 25, 50, 75 or 100. A higher result indicates a more favorable self-rating.

guidance.text:
回看最近的睡眠、工作与日常活动，想想哪些变化对当前的整体感受影响最大。

Consider whether recent changes in sleep, work or daily activity help explain your overall rating.

interpretations.headline: 用一个数字定位此刻的感受
interpretations.scoreLabel: 当下健康自评（0–10 换算）
interpretations.summary:
你在原题的 0–10 量尺上选择一个数字，按附录乘以 10 后呈现。它与五档总体健康评价各自保留，即使两项结果不同，也可以回看两道问题关注的角度。

Your original 0–10 present-health choice is multiplied by 10, as specified in the Annex. Keep this answer separate from your general health rating.

guidance.text:
如果打算跟踪变化，可以在相似情境下再次记录。若不适持续或影响日常，考虑向医疗专业人员说明变化和发生的时间。

If tracking change, record the context each time. If symptoms persist or interfere with daily life, consider discussing the changes and timing with a health professional.

limitations: GH1 与 GH2 分开呈现。GH1 使用附录第 7 种选项。GH2 保留 0–10 原始选项并乘 10 显示。两项均为 0–100 的单项指标，不计算合成分或风险分档。
GH1 category 7 and GH2 category 8 are separate response formats and separate results. There is no composite or diagnostic score.
report.disclaimer: 用于成年工作人群的非商业研究与自我回顾。For non-commercial research with adult workers and personal reflection.
